scientific_integrity: Finite exact computations corroborate, but do not replace, the enumeration and tightness proofs. Historical priority is assessed by direct source comparison, without independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Fixed number D of terminal vertices only; no growing-window functional theorem or rate. Earlier fixed-d root deficit marginal is known. General local limits may imply some asymptotic consequences; exact finite-n marked factorial identity is the independently derived addition. Classical Cayley–Hurwitz forest identities (Pitman 2001) may offer an alternative derivation of the exact identity. The D=1 finite moment case is already implied by Hackl–Panholzer–Wagner Lemma 8; the proposed addition begins with multiple anchors.
title: Terminal anchored-component moments and a marked Poisson–Borel uncovering process
